subject: english
question:
**Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.**

Scarcely had he took the medicine when his headache was gone.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **took the medicine**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Replace **'took'** with** 'taken'** to make the sentence correct.
 
• The given sentence is in the **Past Perfect** Simple tense. We always use **3rd form of the verb** in such sentences.
 
• The **Past Perfect tense** in English is composed of two parts: **the past tense of the verb to have (had) + the past participle of the main verb.__**
 
 
• **Example - **Scarcely had I entered the room when the attendant appeared.
 
 
 
• **​"Scarcely...when"** is used to say that something happens immediately after something else.

Therefore the correct answer is **option 3**.

**Corrected sentence:** *Scarcely had he **taken **the medicine when his headache was gone.*
